_about: Master roster of every AI tool we make videos about. Each gets a superhero avatar (idle + action) generated into assets/toolverse/. The 12 with hand-written powers/voices in universe.json are the comic-cast heroes; the rest appear in battle videos. alias + color + emblem + archetype drive the avatar art. archetype = the DISTINCT superhero type matched to the tool's power (this is what makes each hero look different instead of a generic armored figure). emblem = an ORIGINAL chest crest representing the tool's function (never a real brand logo).
